intent: A diver counting down the metres: slow numbers, then the staggering share of the world's water.
pacing_profile: question read verbatim, three options, 3-s beat, reveal with the number, three one-line beats, punchline + short follow
pause_policy: Pause only at the marked ellipses; the beat is real silence (ticks come from quizscore.py).
title: Where is the DEEPEST lake on Earth?

lines.direction: the question, cold — curiosity comes from the map moving under it
lines.text: Where is the deepest lake on Earth?

lines.direction: quick, each option its own beat

lines.text: Russia: Lake Baikal in Siberia drops to one thousand six hundred and forty-two metres.
That one lake holds about a fifth of all the unfrozen fresh water on the planet.
It is also the oldest, around twenty-five million years, with a seal found nowhere else.
Over three hundred rivers flow in. Only one flows out: the Angara.

lines.direction: punchline, then a short follow — the outro visual asks
lines.text: A lake deeper than most seas. Follow us.
